title: This Fish Crunches Sea Urchins Whole and Guards 10,000 Eggs With Its Mate
subject: wolf eel

scenes.text: This fish eats sea urchins, spines and all. Its mouth is the weapon.
It's the wolf eel, up to eight feet long and about forty pounds.
Most fish swallow food whole. The wolf eel has canines and molars, and it crushes hard shells.
Crabs, snails, mussels and urchins, all crunched up in powerful jaws.
And it's no loner. Wolf eels are believed to mate for life, sharing the same den year after year.
Both parents guard a ball of up to ten thousand eggs, until a larger rival or an octopus drives them out.

description:
The wolf eel crushes crabs, mussels and sea urchins with canine and molar teeth.
It is believed to mate for life, and both parents guard up to ten thousand eggs.
What is the scariest-looking harmless animal you know?
